title: Slope & Inclination of a Straight Line
shortDescription: Practise finding the slope and inclination of straight lines with instant feedback.
intro: Use these rules: slope through two points = (y₂ − y₁) ÷ (x₂ − x₁); slope = tan θ, where θ is the inclination.
seoTitle: GCSE Slope and Inclination Worksheet: Straight Line Graphs | MyTutBuddy
